channel.title: Neuron Flame
channel.description: Voice-to-text at the speed of thought. Free, on-device dictation for macOS.

item.description:
v1.75 — Apple-notarised, fresh About page, "Check for Updates" works

  • Apple-notarised distribution. No more right-click → Open. Drag, double-click, you're in.
  • Working "Check for Updates". A new EdDSA signing key for the Sparkle update channel — future versions install in place with one click.
  • About page rebuilt. A clear mission statement, privacy and infrastructure stats, an inline updates check, evaluation-copy donation flow.
  • Brand cleanup. Final sweep of legacy upstream references in user-facing docs and dialogs.

Free forever. Open source under GPL-3. Built by Barney Sharma.
